newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Bekaert chairman to retire.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Bekaert chairman to retire.

text.p: Baron Jean-Charles Velge, chairman of Belgian steel wire and cord maker Bekaert NV, will retire next May at the company's annual general meeting, the company announced on Friday.
Velge, the grandson of the company's founder Leo Bekaert, will be replaced by Thierry Verhaege de Naeyer, Bekaert's great grandson.
Verhaege de Naeyer was born in 1947 and trained as a lawyer in Belgium and at business school in the United States.
He worked six years in the City of London at banks Rothschilds and Schroders before joining Bekaert, where he has been a board member since 1983.
Velge, born in 1930, entered the company in 1957. He was appointed chairman in 1985.
